# VenueGlide

> VenueGlide OS is cloud-based sports venue management software built for indoor and outdoor sports facilities across Melbourne, Victoria and Australia. It replaces disconnected booking spreadsheets, paper waivers and separate POS/payment tools with one connected operating system.

VenueGlide serves indoor cricket centres, padel and tennis clubs, football/futsal turf, basketball and multi-sport complexes. Core capabilities: online court and facility booking, membership management with automated recurring billing, point-of-sale for pro-shop and café sales, customer CRM, coaching and academy management, and real-time business reporting.

Integrations: Stripe (online payments), Xero (accounting sync), and Igloo smart-lock door access for staffless/after-hours venue entry, alongside other integrations available on request.

Headquartered focus: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Serving venues Australia-wide.
